headline: Riot Platforms Secures AI Data Center Financing Deal with Anthropic
summary: Riot Platforms has entered a financing agreement with AI firm Anthropic to support the construction of new data centers. The deal allows Anthropic to fund development costs in exchange for interest payments structured through rent deductions.
why: Riot Platforms is a major publicly traded Bitcoin mining company transitioning its business model toward high-performance computing and data center infrastructure to diversify revenue streams beyond cryptocurrency mining.

impacts.name: Riot Platforms
impacts.why: The capital injection supports the company's strategic pivot toward AI data center infrastructure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The deal signals a significant shift in Riot's business model from pure-play Bitcoin mining to AI infrastructure, which may impact investor valuation of the company's long-term growth prospects.
